```{r}
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Load in DE genes
```{r}
de <- read.csv("/Volumes/klavine/Active/Haewon/ICELL_10X_paper_revisions/DEGs/icell_unique_fibroblast.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1) # Import genes

gene_df <- bitr(rownames(de),
                fromType="SYMBOL",
                toType="ENTREZID",
                OrgDb=org.Hs.eg.db)
```

```{r}
hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")

enrich <- enricher(
  gene = gene_df$ENTREZID,
  TERM2GENE = hallmark[, c("gs_name","entrez_gene")],
  pvalueCutoff = 0.1
)
```

```{r}
p1 <- dotplot(enrich, showCategory = 15)

ggsave(file.path("/Users/haewonshin/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-WashingtonUniversityinSt.Louis/obsidian/my_vault/lab/experiments/01_icell_10x_paper_revisions/figures/hallmark_icell_fibroblast.pdf"), plot = p1, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 600)
```
